title: Cherry Note Block
description: 这是一款为音符盒与唱片机制作的材质包，灵感来源于樱花木板。(This is a texture pack for note block and jukebox. inspired by cherry plants.)
body:
# **描述**
- **此资源包修改了音符盒与唱片机的材质，采用了原版樱花木板与樱花原木的柔和色调。**
- **粉色克制而温润，不刺眼，适合长期的视觉沉浸。** 
# Description
- **This resource pack reimagines the textures of Note Blocks and Jukeboxes, drawing inspiration from the natural tones of Minecraft's cherry wood.**
- **The pink is deliberately soft and gentle—never harsh on the eyes—designed for long-term visual immersion and a cohesive aesthetic.**
